Expert neurology, dermatology & laser treatments with care

Book Appointment
Monday to Saturday | 3PM - 6PM (Skin, Hair & Aesthetic Clinic - Dr. Nudrath Kahkashan) | 5PM - 8PM (Neurology Clinic - Dr. M. A. Mukheem Mudabbir) | NCS & EEG Lab: 5 PM - 9 PM | Pharmacy: 9 AM - 9 PM | Appointments: +91 7093437323

Why Choose Us

  • Experienced senior neurologist with 13+ years in diagnosis and treatment.
  • Experienced Gold Medalist Dermatologist, Aesthetist, and Laser Specialist.
  • Multi-specialty care in neurology, dermatology, cosmetology, and psychiatry.
  • Advanced neurodiagnostic technology for accurate diagnoses and treatments.
  • Safe, result-oriented dermatology and cosmetology services.
  • Personalized treatment plans focused on individual health and wellness.
  • 24/7 pharmacy and diagnostic lab for quick access to medicines and reports.

Gracious Hospital: Your Trusted Neuro and Dermatology Care in Mehdipatnam

Gracious Hospital, located in Mehdipatnam, Hyderabad, is recognized as the best neuro, dermatology, and cosmetology hospital specializing in neurological, skin, and aesthetic disorders. We understand that many conditions often go undiagnosed or are difficult to treat. Our expert team, led by Dr. M. A. Mukheem Mudabbir, a renowned neurologist, focuses on accurate diagnoses and comprehensive treatments for conditions like epilepsy, migraine, Parkinsons disease, stroke, and nerve pain.

Our dermatology and cosmetology departments, led by Dr. Nudrath Kahkashan, provide advanced treatments for psoriasis, acne scars, skin pigmentation, and cosmetic concerns. Whether you are searching for top neurologists or expert dermatologists and cosmetologists in Mehdipatnam, Gracious Hospital offers compassionate care and specialized treatments. Here, we believe that hope meets healing for every patient.

Read More

Our Services

Neurology Services

Expert neurology care for stroke, epilepsy, migraine, neuropathy & pediatric neurological disorders with advanced diagnosis and treatment.

Neurodiagnostic Tests

Advanced neurodiagnostic tests for accurate brain and nerve evaluation, enabling early detection and effective neurological treatment.

Neurological Procedures

Advanced neurological procedures, including Botox for migraines, lumbar puncture, nerve blocks, and stroke rehabilitation.

Clinical Dermatology

Comprehensive dermatology treatments for acne, pigmentation, infections & chronic skin conditions using advanced medical care.

Cosmetology Procedures

Advanced cosmetology treatments including laser therapy, anti-aging, skin rejuvenation & hair care for healthy glowing skin.

Dermatosurgery

Dermatosurgery unit specializes in skin cancer, cysts, moles, warts, and scars using advanced techniques like Mohs surgery.

View More Services

Our Doctors

Dr. M. A. Mukheem Mudabbir

MBBS (Osmania Medical College), MD (Internal Medicine), DM (Neurology – NIMHANS)

Senior Consultant Neurologist and Adult & Pediatric Epileptologist

Dr. Nudrath Kahkashan

MBBS (Gold Medalist), MD-DVL(OSM), Certified Aesthetist.

Consultant Dermatologist, Aesthetist and laser specialist.

Need More Help or Information?

Contact us today and let our dedicated team assist you with all your healthcare needs.

Book Appointment

News & Media
What services are available at the clinic?

We offer neurology, dermatology, cosmetology, psychiatry, diagnostics, and day-care procedures under one roof.

Who is the neurologist at the clinic?

Dr. M A Mukheem Mudabbir is a senior neurologist with 13+ years of experience.

Do you provide skin and hair treatments?

Yes, we offer advanced dermatology, cosmetology, and laser treatments for skin and hair care.

Is diagnostic testing available at the clinic?

Yes, we provide neurodiagnostic tests and lab services for accurate diagnosis.

Is pharmacy available at the clinic?

Yes, we have a 24/7 in-house pharmacy for patient convenience.

Frequently Asked Questions

I had an excellent experience with this Dr Mukheem neurologist. From the very first consultation, they were attentive, patient, and genuinely concerned about understanding my condition in detail. Dr Mukheem took the time to listen carefully to my father's symptoms, asked thoughtful questions, and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand.

What stood out most was his thorough approach to diagnosis and treatment. Dr Mukheem didn’t rush the process and made sure my father was comfortable and informed at every step. Dr Mukheem expertise and confidence immediately put me at ease, and I felt reassured that my father was in capable hands.

The treatment plan he provided was clear and effective, and he was always available to address any follow-up questions or concerns. The clinic staff was also professional and supportive, which made the overall experience even better.

I highly recommend this gracious clinic to anyone seeking knowledgeable, compassionate, and patient-centered care.
